title_ru: Осирис — проверка общей матрицы, маскулинизации и биологического пола

positive_precedent.HATSHEPSUT: A known female ruler was represented as the ideal male king with false beard and masculine regalia, while inscriptions still retained feminine forms/name. This proves representational masculinization without proving concealment.
positive_precedent.NEFERNEFERUATEN: Met catalogues a female pharaoh Neferneferuaten; current discussions include Nefertiti or Meritaten as candidates.
positive_precedent.SEKHMET: Major explicitly female war/protection deity; weakens any premise that Egyptian audiences required male deities for martial loyalty.

royal_mummy_control_set.Hatshepsut: female ruler; male royal iconography known before mummy identification
royal_mummy_control_set.KV55_probable_Akhenaten: male in checked CT/genetic lineage work
royal_mummy_control_set.Tutankhamun: male; preserved genital evidence noted despite feminized Amarna art
royal_mummy_control_set.Tiye_Elder_Lady: female mummy later identified as queen, not male king reversed to female
